description: Local open-network VLIW wiring smoke for Plain Codex with gpt-5.6-sol medium.

protocol_override_reasons.backend: the local smoke uses Docker instead of the official Kubernetes backend
protocol_override_reasons.model: the local smoke validates the selected development model
protocol_override_reasons.reasoning_effort: reasoning effort is pinned explicitly for reproducibility
protocol_override_reasons.timeout: the local wiring smoke uses a five-minute task budget
protocol_override_reasons.attempts_per_task: the local wiring smoke runs one trajectory instead of three paper trajectories
protocol_override_reasons.cell_concurrency: the local wiring smoke runs one task cell
protocol_override_reasons.judge_concurrency: the local shared Judge serializes ephemeral Judge containers
protocol_override_reasons.eval_interval: the five-minute smoke evaluates once per minute so it always records hidden-Judge evidence before the agent deadline
protocol_override_reasons.internet: the local Codex OAuth smoke uses the validated open-network container path because host iptables isolation is unavailable
